column1: TABLE RoommateStatus-main-groups - households / groups (one item per household). The JoinCodeIndex GSI (partition key joinCode, ProjectionType ALL) powers join-by-code lookups. showRoster, showFeed, and showBookClub are group-wide admin controls; absent values on pre-existing rows are read as true. Local seed data includes yorkshire / YORKSHIRE (roster + feed) and book-club / BOOKCLUB (Book Club only).
